input.command:
mkdir -p /work && cat > /work/opt.py <<'EOF'
import re, subprocess, os, random, shutil, sys

APP='/app'
orig=open('/app/input.orig.tex').read()
fams=[]
for line in open('/app/synonyms.txt'):
    line=line.strip()
    if not line: continue
    fams.append([w.strip() for w in line.split(',')])
head={f[0].lower():f for f in fams}

# tokenize occurrences of head words
pat=re.compile(r'[A-Za-z]+')
slots=[]  # (start,end,family,origword)
for m in pat.finditer(orig):
    w=m.group(0)
    if w.lower() in head:
        slots.append((m.start(),m.end(),head[w.lower()],w))
print(len(slots),'slots',file=sys.stderr)

def cap(orig_w, new_w):
    if orig_w[0].isupper():
        return new_w[0].upper()+new_w[1:]
    return new_w

def build(choice):
    out=[]; prev=0
    for i,(s,e,fam,w) in enumerate(slots):
        out.append(orig[prev:s]); out.append(cap(w,fam[choice[i]])); prev=e
    out.append(orig[prev:])
    return ''.join(out)

RUN='/work/run'
os.makedirs(RUN,exist_ok=True)
shutil.copy('/app/main.tex',RUN+'/main.tex')
ovre=re.compile(r'Overfull \\hbox \(([0-9.]+)pt too wide\)')

cache={}
def score(choice):
    key=tuple(choice)
    if key in cache: return cache[key]
    txt=build(choice)
    open(RUN+'/input.tex','w').write(txt)
    subprocess.run(['pdflatex','-interaction=nonstopmode','main.tex'],cwd=RUN,
                   stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    log=open(RUN+'/main.log',errors='ignore').read()
    vals=[float(x) for x in ovre.findall(log)]
    r=(len(vals), sum(vals))
    cache[key]=r
    return r

choice=[0]*len(slots)
best=score(choice)
print('base',best,file=sys.stderr)
improved=True
rounds=0
while improved and rounds<8:
    improved=False; rounds+=1
    order=list(range(len(slots)))
    random.shuffle(order)
    for i in order:
        fam=slots[i][2]
        cur=choice[i]
        for j in range(len(fam)):
            if j==cur: continue
            choice[i]=j
            s=score(choice)
            if s<best:
                best=s; cur=j; improved=True
                print('improve',best,slots[i][3],'->',fam[j],file=sys.stderr)
            else:
                choice[i]=cur
        if best[0]==0:
            break
    print('round',rounds,best,file=sys.stderr)
    if best[0]==0: break

open('/work/best.tex','w').write(build(choice))
print('FINAL',best)
EOF
cd /work && timeout 3000 python3 opt.py
